name: Unified MQTT Platform for Automotive
description: MQTT platform for connected cars and software-defined vehicles. EMQX powers 20M+ vehicles, trusted by top OEMs; scalable, secure automotive IoV data backbone.

mainEntity.name: How many electric cars does EMQX currently connect?

acceptedAnswer.text: EMQX provides connectivity for over 20 million electric vehicles and connected cars globally. This proven data backbone supports large-scale EV fleets and vehicle-to-cloud communications, enabling remote control, data monitoring, and real-time telemetry. EMQX is trusted by leading OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers and supports 100+ car models and partnerships with 50+ automobile companies, making it a scalable, reliable foundation for global automotive IoV deployments.

mainEntity.name: What are the core benefits of using MQTT for automotive telematics?

acceptedAnswer.text: MQTT is lightweight and efficient, reducing data transfer costs and battery consumption for in-vehicle devices. It provides real-time, low-latency communication essential for vehicle tracking, remote diagnostics, and emergency services. These characteristics enable critical automotive use cases such as over-the-air updates, bidirectional command and control, and high-performance fleet telematics while minimizing bandwidth and power overhead for T-Box and in-vehicle gateways.

mainEntity.name: Can EMQX support millions of vehicles simultaneously?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. EMQX is a distributed, high-performance MQTT broker designed to handle millions of concurrent connections and route massive volumes of telemetry data per second. The platform ingests petabytes of telemetry without dropping messages, supports cloud-edge unified management, and is architected to meet the scale and reliability requirements of global OEMs and telematics providers for large-scale connected vehicle deployments.

mainEntity.name: How does EMQX improve efficiency in automotive manufacturing?

acceptedAnswer.text: EMQX acts as a unified Industrial IoT (IIoT) data backbone that collects and processes real-time data from robots, PLCs, and sensors across the factory floor. By streaming IIoT data into analytics and operational systems, EMQX enables predictive maintenance, automated quality control, optimized production flow, improved traceability across manufacturing and supply chains, and faster responses to regulatory and market changes—helping manufacturers increase uptime and operational efficiency.
